guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice latency-90 rose from 0.0096 to 0.4379 (z=+893) and latency-50 from 0.0075 to 0.2381, the largest shifts of any series, while its downstream productcatalogservice latency is essentially flat (+8%). Frontend latency rises as a consequence, no cpu/mem/socket anomaly appears on recommendationservice in the top series, and there are no error logs or error spans, which points to added delay rather than a crash or loss.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice for network delay or slow handlers (e.g. injected latency, tc/netem rules) on its pods, and restart or reschedule the affected pods if a delay rule or degraded node is found; non-destructive checks first.
